about_the_game: Drone District is an adrenaline-charged FPV arcade experience that mashes up the flow of Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater with the freedom of Burnout Paradise—but with drones. Master flight tricks, grind power lines, launch off rooftops, chain mid-air stunts, and explore Beachtown.

  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD R9 270X
